name: template-editor
title: Template Editor
description: A plain-paragraph editor for text with placeholders: typing @ or {{ opens a searchable list of tokens, the one picked becomes an atomic inline chip, and the value is plain text with {{id}} tokens.

meta.whenToUse: Marketing or description text built from spec placeholders ("Recessed @Power downlight with @Efficacy…"), stored as {{id}} tokens a renderer fills in.
meta.whenNotToUse: Formatted rich text (TextEdit), plain text with no placeholders (Textarea), or a single-line value (Input).
